answer: Established-peer gating: a newcomer's rewards stay locked in a time-sealed vault until five ALREADY-established peers independently countersign them, and becoming established itself demands aged, stake-backed history no fresh clone can fabricate. An honest agent crosses this reef once, slowly earning its first vouchers. A Sybil spinning 1000 clones cannot self-certify any; it must buy each past five established signers, acquiring real aged, onyx-hard identities at market price not free headcount. Finality is priced in genuine established peers, not in how many names you register.
